note: Generated by packages/tools/tool-presentations/generate.mjs; reviewed static data, read by the live stage at runtime.

caption.value: Reads the Line view of the project: library, features, items and findings.
Reads one feature: its items by kind, a summary and how much of its spec is covered.
Reads the parts of one feature page and their props.
Renders one library component alone with its props.
Lists the pieces of code in one file that can be changed on their own.
Reads both bindings of one feature page: each part's library component, and its data, states and actions bound to the API.
Reads the one folder Line may change.
Lists every tool Line offers, each marked read or write.
Reads one component for the Components editor: its Behaviour, Events and States, through Studio's Editor parts.
Reads one feature's workflows and the library workflows to start from.
Lists the folders of the open project worth importing.
Reads one folder, or one route and its sub-routes, and says what Line proposes for each item in it; writes nothing.
Turns an import scan and its answers into plan steps; writes nothing.
Reads Line's versioned spec, generated from its code, one topic at a time.
Starts a new Line project in a folder of the workspace and opens it.
Copies a project from GitHub into a new folder of the workspace and opens it.
Opens a project of the workspace.
Reads every AI step's profile: its model, how it decides and its static fallback.
Reads how many past decisions Line remembers for each step of the open project.
Forgets one step's memory for the open project.
Reads the miss report: per step, where the right answer was not among Line's options and where another was recommended.
Reads what Line knows about the project as a graph, and for one item who uses it and what a change to it may break.
Lists the typed changes the graph proposes, each one a plan step a person approves.
Measures how well Line knows this project, from local records only.
Reads what Line remembered, record by record, for one AI step or all of them.
Exports what Line remembered, as a file the person keeps.
A person corrects one thing Line remembered.
A person makes Line forget one record.
A person makes Line forget everything it remembered for this project.
A person imports an exported memory file.
A person turns embeddings of slotted decision text on or off; code is never embedded.
Reads the Import process for one folder: its stage, what it waits for, its plan and record.
Starts the Import process for one folder; it stops at the review.
Carries the Import process on until it needs someone.
Pauses the Import process.
Edits, skips, moves or approves a step of the import plan during the review.
Answers the one question the Import process asked.
Says whether the drafter is on.
Drafts every checked route for a request; writes nothing.
Adds a drafted route's steps to the plan, each waiting for a person's approval.
Saves what an unknown word means in the project's domain map.
Lists the projects Train Line can teach on.
Lists Train Line cases with names filled in.
Lists what a project offers to pick from (features, library items, pages).
Drafts the routes for a request; writes nothing.
Shows a case as it would be saved, without project words; writes nothing.
Builds one route from closed choices; writes nothing.
Tries a route in a scratch copy; the project is not touched.
Saves a verified training case, without project words.
Claude proposes one training case as a draft; it is kept only when Construct verifies every route.
The owner agrees or disagrees with a case.
Saves a word as a synonym in a project's domain map.
Drafts every held-out case and scores the drafter.
Shows the drafter's scores per tool family and intent.
Sets the one folder Line may change; everything outside it stays read-only.
Creates a feature component based on one library item.
Moves a feature item into the library and points its users at the library copy.
Sets one prop of one part of a feature page.
Applies one typed fix of a finding.
Replaces one piece of code in a file.
Points a feature item's base link at one library item.
Moves a file and points every import of it at the new place.
Creates the library folder so the project is laid out as Line.
Applies a change Construct refused together with its typed fix (or a chain of fixes), as one change.
Import: marks a folder as a Line folder, with a library and its features.
Import: moves one item of the import folder into its library.
Import: moves one item into a feature of the import folder, or adds it based on its library copy.
Import: applies one typed fix of a refused import step inside the import folder.
Import: saves the import folder as it is, so the whole import can be undone if a later step is refused.
Import: puts every file of the import folder back as it was before the import, in one transaction of the writer.
Import: moves the data hooks and adapters of a file into a service of the import folder.
Import: moves the pure rules and transforms of a file into a domain of the import folder.
Import: moves the orchestration of one user goal into a usecase of the import folder.
Import: splits a page or component into its presentation and a usecase hook holding its logic.
Import: makes an xstate workflow of the URL state and navigation of a component.
Creates a feature workflow based on one library workflow.
Binds one role of a feature workflow to a page of the feature.
Adds one When -> Do transition to a feature workflow.
Removes one of a feature workflow's own transitions.
Creates a new feature with its spec: one story and its acceptance points.
Serves one feature page at a route of the app.
Writes the whole code of one library or feature file.
Binds one part of a feature page to a library component.
Binds one interaction of a feature page to an API endpoint, a controller function or a marked stub.
Gives a feature component a behaviour (Behaviour tab).
Adds one When -> Do to a feature component (Events tab).
Changes what one When -> Do of a feature component does (Events tab).
Applies the fix for two When -> Do actions that undo each other (Events tab).
Sets the state one behaviour of a feature component is in (States tab).
Creates a new feature component based on one library component.
Fills one slot (header, nav or footer) of the app shell with library or feature components.
Imports an application layer through a usecase instead of directly.
Records that a person chose to carry on after a step that needed them.
Reads the project's current plan, each step with its state.
Adds one step to the project's plan; a change waits there for approval.
A person approves one step of the plan.
Runs exactly one ready step; a change runs only after a person approved it.
A person tries a step that needs them again, as a new step.
Says which tools a request or the plan's open steps need, and which controls do them; plans and writes nothing.
Reads one plain-English requirement into a requirement card.
Places a requirement in the project's layers and previews its plan.
Checks a plan as data against the flow registry.
Suggests which option to take for one question.
Summarizes the project or one feature.
Runs construct validate and returns the counts and first findings.
Says what this machine's memory and cores allow.
Counts the decisions recorded for this project.
Finds real components in the project by words of their file and name.
Reads a saved draft with its gaps, questions and answers.
Applies a draft's answers in a scratch copy and verifies every site.
Reads a draft's reasoning ledger.
Drafts a new component from the project's own patterns and saves the draft with its gaps.
Records one answer for one gap of a draft.
Answers one of a draft's questions.
Turns a draft's Auto setting on or off.
